answer.sql:
WITH deal_sales AS (
  SELECT
    d.specialdealid,
    d.dealdescription,
    COALESCE(SUM(il.extendedprice), 0) AS total_sales
  FROM wideworldimporters.sales.specialdeals d
  LEFT JOIN wideworldimporters.sales.invoices i
    ON i.invoicedate BETWEEN d.startdate AND d.enddate
  LEFT JOIN wideworldimporters.sales.customers c
    ON c.customerid = i.customerid
   AND (d.customerid IS NULL OR d.customerid = c.customerid)
   AND (d.buyinggroupid IS NULL OR d.buyinggroupid = c.buyinggroupid)
   AND (d.customercategoryid IS NULL OR d.customercategoryid = c.customercategoryid)
  LEFT JOIN wideworldimporters.sales.invoicelines il
    ON il.invoiceid = i.invoiceid
   AND il.stockitemid = d.stockitemid
   AND c.customerid IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY d.specialdealid, d.dealdescription
)
SELECT
  specialdealid,
  dealdescription,
  total_sales
FROM deal_sales
ORDER BY total_sales DESC, specialdealid
LIMIT 1
